lines.trans: Do they trick all newcomers like that?
I must quickly put on my chef's hat.
Chef, today is the fifteenth, do you remember?
Soon the restaurant's sanitary inspection will arrive.
And in your kitchen there is a mess again!
Where do you see a mess, my dear?
Look for yourself what a clean shelf this is!
A little money solves any big problems.
If there were order, we wouldn't pay!
There is always a lot of work in a restaurant kitchen.
Inspectors look for violations only for money.
We must urgently establish perfect cleanliness.
It seems today we have big problems.
I will go wash the floors in the kitchen.

wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have
